name: rushing/laravel-prism-plus
description: Wrap-and-extend over Prism — delegates the existing modalities to prism-php/prism and adds the ones Prism has no slot for (rerank, and later audio/video) as parallel first-class modalities that reuse Prism's own provider credentials.

repositories.//: Local co-dev resolution of the popcorn kernel: when the sibling checkout exists this path repo wins, so standalone dev uses the live package. Both repos here are read only when prism-plus is the composer root (its own standalone test suite); when prism-plus is consumed as a git dependency, composer reads the consuming root's repositories instead, so neither leaks into a shipped lock.
Git fallback for a fresh standalone clone with no sibling checkout (e.g. the package's own CI), since popcorn is not on Packagist.

suggest.rushing/prism-cassette: Record/replay rerank calls as fixtures (soft-inject; no hard dependency)
